ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2024-11-01..2025-10-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-31..2026-07-31

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-31..2026-07-31

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

net_buyback_yield.label: ≤ 5.53%
net_buyback_yield.note: share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

shareholder_yield.label: ≤ 6.32%
shareholder_yield.note: share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters — no deduction made, so this yield is an upper bound

notes: quarterly DPS (declared): 2 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2018-04-30: 0.11 (filed 2018-06-05) used, not 0.08 (filed 2019-06-06) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2017-11-01..2018-04-30 − 2017-11-01..2018-01-31); 2021-04-30: 0.17 (filed 2021-06-03) used, not 0.11 (filed 2021-09-02) — the value the year-to-date facts give (2020-11-01..2021-04-30 − 2020-11-01..2021-01-31)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (184 days between 2025-07-31 and 2026-01-31) — FY2025 DPS 0.98 + the quarters since (2026-01-31: 0.25, 2026-04-30: 0.26, 2026-07-31: 0.26) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-01-31: 0.23, 2025-04-30: 0.25, 2025-07-31: 0.25)
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-10-31, 2026-01-31, 2026-04-30, 2026-07-31)
